## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant task IDs.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Distinguish recorded evidence from
fresh execution, and explain any expected failures or unverified behavior.

## Review and rollback

Describe meaningful constraints, dependent changes and how this PR can be reverted.

- [ ] Diff and focused commit history reviewed.
- [ ] Required checks pass; no secrets or generated run artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and task status reflect measured implementation evidence.
